description: Legitimate calls that both revisions must keep working: a scoped orchestrator operating on its own descendants, and a non-scoped api-key caller using the same tools.

probes.note: The caller is an ancestor of the target, so the central scope gate must let it through on both revisions.
Authorized mutation on a direct child task.
The session resolves to a descendant task, so the session branch of the same gate must allow it.
Non-scoped api-key callers keep full tool access; the fix must not restrict them.
